title: Creator Videos as Meta Ads: Usage Rights, Attribution and the Real Cost of Reusing Content
summary: Turn performance-proven creator videos into Meta ads. Learn how to secure usage rights, pay creators on commission or ad spend, and attribute every sale to the creator who made it.
body_markdown:
## Per-Creator Attribution: Tying Every Meta Sale to the Creator Who Made It


When creator videos as meta ads run under a brand’s account, campaign-level results do not automatically show which creator made the video behind each sale. Assign each asset a creator identity before launch, then preserve that connection in the campaign name, tracking setup, and payment record. This makes it easier to compare creative performance and apply the compensation terms you agreed upon.


### Why Ad-Level Reporting Without Creator Identity Leaves Money on the Table


A reporting view can show spend, clicks, and purchases while still obscuring who created the ad. If several videos share a campaign without consistent naming, teams can misread the results, overlook a useful creative, or miscalculate a creator’s payment. Create a record for each creator and video, and keep the ad identifier connected to that record as the campaign runs.


Use a consistent naming pattern, such as creator name, asset identifier, and version. Check that the reported attribution basis matches the agreement, whether compensation follows attributed revenue or ad spend. That connection gives your team a clearer trail from creative asset to ad delivery, reported conversion, and payout review.


### Connecting Meta Creator Video Results to Shopify, Amazon and Retail Sales


Meta reporting can describe activity within its ad environment, but a brand may also need to assess sales across its wider business. Keep channel-level reporting distinct from creator-level ad attribution: connecting a sale to an ad and creator is not the same as measuring whether that ad caused incremental sales across every channel.


Reacher’s[Halo Effect](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/halo-effect) connects TikTok content to Amazon, Shopify, and retail sales and calculates cross-channel ROAS. It is designed for measuring the relationship between TikTok content and those sales, not for claiming that a Meta ad generated each off-platform purchase. Define which channel and content source a measurement represents before using it to guide budget decisions.


### Reacher's Meta Ads Integration: Attribution and Payouts in One Loop


[Reacher’s Meta Ads](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/meta-ads) integration turns creator videos with usage rights into Facebook and Instagram ads, with per-creator attribution and commissions based on revenue or ad spend. Stripe handles creator payouts. Keeping those elements connected gives teams a practical route from a creator’s authorized video to results review and payment, while the agreement remains the reference for rights and compensation.


For the next campaign, use AI Creator Search to find creators through a plain-English profile description, a creator transcript, a product image, or a lookalike of a creator already working. AI Creator Search helps build a relevant shortlist; evaluate each selected video and its results before choosing assets for paid distribution.
